title: Black Hole Sun
tracks: Kim Thayil | Guild S-100 Polara | Lead Guitar
Chris Cornell | Gretsch Duo Jet | Rhythm Guitar
Chris Cornell | Gretsch Duo Jet | Rhythm Guitar Effects
Kim Thayil | Guild S-100 Polara | Guitar Overdubs
Matt Cameron | Yamaha Absolute Hybrid Maple | Drums
tempoNote: Notated in half time (53 BPM); the recording is about 106 BPM.

lines.text: And the sun in my disgrace.
'Neath the black, the sky looks dead.
And I'll hear you scream again.
Steal the warm wind, tired friend.
Sometimes, far too long for snakes.
In my youth, I pray to keep.
No one sings like you anymore.
